_comment: Technologies, in three kinds of research: military (weapons, tactics, the philosophy of war), admin (governing the realm: government, taxation, law) and science (inventions and learning). cost: research points. requires: techs that must be known first, of any kind. condition (and condition_text): anything else the country must meet before research points flow into it (see the flag conditions in data/countries/EGY.json; also owns_feature). modifiers: the country's numbers once known, with the keys of data/laws.json, plus research (share more research), army_attack and army_defense (share stronger in battle), army_speed (share faster on the march), diplomats (more diplomats), levy_share (share more levied). known_at_start: every settled country knows it at the start. What unit types (data/units.json 'tech') and law options (data/laws.json requires {tech}) a tech opens is shown with it.

techs.name: Bronze Working
techs.description: Copper and tin melted together: bronze blades, spearheads and armour.

techs.name: Archery
techs.description: The composite bow, of wood, horn and sinew.

techs.name: Horse Domestication
techs.description: Horses tamed and bred to pull loads.

techs.name: Chariotry
techs.description: Light spoked-wheel chariots, the weapon of Bronze Age kings.

techs.name: Iron Working
techs.description: Smelting and forging iron: harder to work than bronze, but its ore is everywhere.

techs.name: Horseback Riding
techs.description: Fighting from the horse's back, not from a chariot behind it.

techs.name: Siege Engineering
techs.description: Siege towers, armoured rams and the art of the mine under the wall.

techs.name: Scale Armour
techs.description: Coats of overlapping iron scales.

techs.name: Heavy Chariots
techs.description: Four horses and a crew of three, built to break infantry.

techs.name: Drill
techs.description: Soldiers trained to march and fight in step.

techs.name: Phalanx
techs.description: Heavy spearmen shoulder to shoulder behind their shields.

techs.name: Horse Archery
techs.description: Shooting at the gallop, as the peoples of the steppe do.

techs.name: Treatises on War
techs.description: The philosophy of war written down: know the enemy and know yourself.

techs.name: Torsion Engines
techs.description: Twisted sinew springs that hurl stones and bolts: the catapult.

techs.name: Sarissa Phalanx
techs.description: Pikes of eighteen feet, five rows of points before the front rank.

techs.name: Legion Tactics
techs.description: Flexible cohorts of drilled swordsmen with javelins and great shields.

techs.name: Cataphracts
techs.description: Horse and rider armoured head to hoof.

techs.name: The Stirrup
techs.description: Feet held firm: a rider can take the shock of the lance.

techs.name: Knighthood
techs.description: Armoured lancers bound to their lord by oath and land.

techs.name: Crossbow
techs.description: A bow drawn by a crank: it pierces mail in the hands of a peasant.

techs.name: Counterweight Engines
techs.description: The trebuchet, whose falling weight throws stones that break walls.

techs.name: Firearms
techs.description: The arquebus and the musket.

techs.name: Cannon
techs.description: Bronze and iron guns that bring down any wall.

techs.name: Rifling
techs.description: Spiral grooves in the barrel: guns that hit what they aim at, far away.

techs.name: Armoured Warfare
techs.description: The tank: the motor vehicle armoured and armed, heir to the horse.

techs.name: Modern Warfare
techs.description: Machine guns, trenches, lorries and the radio.

techs.name: Chiefdom
techs.description: A chief and his kin rule the villages.

techs.name: Tribute
techs.description: The people owe a share of their harvest to their ruler.

techs.name: Monarchy
techs.description: A king above the chiefs, and a court around him.

techs.name: Code of Laws
techs.description: The laws written down, and judges to keep them.

techs.name: Divine Kingship
techs.description: The ruler is a god among men, or their chosen one.

techs.name: Diplomacy
techs.description: Envoys, letters and treaties between rulers.

techs.name: Bureaucracy
techs.description: Officials in every province, keeping the accounts of the state.

techs.name: Census
techs.description: Every household counted: the state knows who owes tax and service.

techs.name: Currency
techs.description: Coins of a known weight, struck by the state.

techs.name: Provincial Governors
techs.description: Satraps and governors who rule the provinces in the king's name.

techs.name: Royal Roads
techs.description: Paved roads and way stations from one end of the realm to the other.

techs.name: Republic
techs.description: Rule by elected magistrates and a council of citizens.

techs.name: Imperial Administration
techs.description: One law, one coinage and one tax from sea to sea.

techs.name: Feudalism
techs.description: Land for service: lords hold the provinces and bring their men to war.

techs.name: Banking
techs.description: Letters of credit, loans and the counting house.

techs.name: The Nation State
techs.description: A people, a language and a state as one.

techs.name: Pottery
techs.description: Fired clay vessels to store grain, oil and water.

techs.name: Priesthood
techs.description: Men and women set apart to serve the gods, keepers of the oldest learning.

techs.name: Writing
techs.description: Signs that hold words: hieroglyphs, cuneiform.

techs.name: Masonry
techs.description: Cut stone and fired brick: walls, temples, tombs.

techs.name: Sailing
techs.condition_text: A coast or a river in the realm
techs.description: Boats with sails, on the river and along the coasts.

techs.name: Calendar
techs.description: The year counted in days and months, by the sun, the moon and the stars.

techs.name: Mathematics
techs.description: Numbers, fractions and the measure of fields.

techs.name: Medicine
techs.description: Healers who set bones and treat wounds from written remedies.

techs.name: Alphabet
techs.description: A few letters for the sounds of speech: writing anyone can learn.

techs.name: Astronomy
techs.description: The courses of the stars and planets, watched and written down.

techs.name: Engineering
techs.description: Aqueducts, bridges and cranes.

techs.name: Philosophy
techs.description: The love of wisdom: reason asks what the gods and the world are.

techs.name: Theology
techs.description: Scriptures and their teachers.

techs.name: Paper
techs.description: Cheap sheets of pressed fibre: books for many.

techs.name: Mechanics
techs.description: Levers, gears and screws.

techs.name: Gunpowder
techs.description: Saltpetre, sulphur and charcoal: the fire drug.

techs.name: Printing Press
techs.description: Movable type: a thousand books where there was one.

techs.name: Scientific Method
techs.description: Observe, measure, test, and doubt.

techs.name: Steam Power
techs.description: The engine that works without horse, wind or water.

techs.name: Internal Combustion
techs.description: The motor: fire inside the engine, and the motor vehicle.
